title: Cosmic Lotus Vision
description: A surreal cosmic scene features a large glowing purple sphere containing a dark-skinned person with curly hair looking upward while holding lotuses, with a faint face and multiple eyes visible behind them. Below, a smaller figure stands on a rocky cliff holding a glowing orb, surrounded by floating lotuses, colorful energy tendrils, a red ringed planet, a blue planet, and a starry space background with constellations and ghostly figures.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene with a large glowing purple sphere in the center containing a dark-skinned person with curly hair looking upward, holding white lotuses, with a translucent face and multiple eyes behind them inside the orb. Below on the bottom left, a small figure stands on a rocky cliff holding a glowing orb. Colorful yellow, blue and pink energy tendrils radiate from the sphere. In the background are a red ringed planet, a blue planet, floating purple lotuses, white ghostly figures, constellations and stars on a black space background.
